description: This file defines the HolidayService class which manages holiday data, including fetching, caching, updating user settings, toggling holidays, and conflict detection. It interacts with external repositories and constants, and provides holiday-related functionalities within a larger application.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: A service class for managing holiday data, user settings, holiday toggling, and conflict detection.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of supported countries based on configured holiday calendars.

methods.name: isSupportedCountry
methods.description: Checks if a given country code is supported.

methods.name: getUserSettings
methods.description: Fetches user holiday settings and associated holidays.

methods.name: updateSettings
methods.description: Updates user holiday settings and retrieves the updated list of holidays.

methods.name: cachedHolidayToHoliday
methods.description: Converts cached holiday data to a standard Holiday object, ensuring UTC date formatting.

methods.name: getHolidaysForCountry
methods.description: Retrieves holidays for a specific country and year.

methods.name: getHolidaysWithStatus
methods.description: Retrieves holidays with enabled/disabled status for a country.

methods.name: getHolidayDatesInRange
methods.description: Gets holiday dates within a specified date range for a country, considering disabled holidays.

methods.name: hasHolidaysInRange
methods.description: Checks if there are any holidays within a date range for a country.

methods.name: toggleHoliday
methods.description: Enables or disables a holiday for a user and updates the disabled holidays list.

methods.name: checkConflicts
methods.description: Detects booking conflicts with holidays within a certain date range.
